title: Approximating inter-point distances in directed Bernoulli graphs
summary: In directed random graphs, in which edges can be assigned to have one of two directions, or perhaps both, the distance between two vertices $v$ and $v'$ can be computed along paths that are directed from $v$ to $v'$, or along paths that are directed from $v'$ to $v$. These two distances are in general dependent.
